Question Choices: Select. If two rays point in exactly opposite directions to form a straight line, what do we call this angle?: ~~Acute-angle | Right-angle | Obtuse-angle | Straight-angle~~
Hints: Compare with 90 degrees and 180 degrees: acute below 90, right 90, obtuse between 90 and 180, straight 180.
Solution: Opposite rays form a half turn of 180 degrees, a straight angle. Acute is below 90, right is 90, and obtuse is between 90 and 180.

Hints: Compare with 90 degrees and 180 degrees: acute below 90, right 90, obtuse between 90 and 180, straight 180.
Solution: 178 degrees is greater than 90 but less than 180, so it is obtuse.
